mapper.sql: RESEARCH_NO, RESEARCH_TITLE, RESEARCH_CONTENTS, ADD_COMMENT, APP_CNT, APP_NEW_CNT, COMPANY_NAME, SERVER_NAME, CONTACT_NO, BROKERAGE_AMT, CALCULATE_YN, REMARK, REGIST_DT, MODIFY_DT, CLOSE_DATE

sql.if: AND ( r.RESEARCH_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.COMPANY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.SERVER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.CONTACT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.REMARK LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.ADD_COMMENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TB_RESEARCH_MST WHERE COMPANY_NAME = #{companyName} ORDER BY RESEARCH_NO DESC

choose.when:
SELECT r.RESEARCH_NO, r.RESEARCH_TITLE, r.RESEARCH_CONTENTS, r.ADD_COMMENT, COUNT(a.RESEARCH_NO) AS APP_CNT, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN a.PROVIDE_YN IS NULL OR a.PROVIDE_YN != 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS APP_NEW_CNT, r.COMPANY_NAME, r.SERVER_NAME, r.CONTACT_NO, r.BROKERAGE_AMT, r.CALCULATE_YN, r.REMARK, r.REGIST_DT, r.MODIFY_DT, r.CLOSE_DATE FROM ( SELECT r.RESEARCH_NO, r.RESEARCH_TITLE, r.RESEARCH_CONTENTS, r.ADD_COMMENT, r.COMPANY_NAME, r.SERVER_NAME, r.CONTACT_NO, r.BROKERAGE_AMT, r.CALCULATE_YN, r.REMARK, r.REGIST_DT, r.MODIFY_DT, r.CLOSE_DATE FROM TB_RESEARCH_MST r WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY r.RESEARCH_NO DESC LIMIT 2000 ) r LEFT JOIN TB_RESEARCH_APP a ON a.RESEARCH_NO = r.RESEARCH_NO GROUP BY r.RESEARCH_NO, r.RESEARCH_TITLE, r.RESEARCH_CONTENTS, r.ADD_COMMENT, r.COMPANY_NAME, r.SERVER_NAME, r.CONTACT_NO, r.BROKERAGE_AMT, r.CALCULATE_YN, r.REMARK, r.REGIST_DT, r.MODIFY_DT, r.CLOSE_DATE ORDER BY CASE WHEN APP_NEW_CNT > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, APP_NEW_CNT DESC, APP_CNT DESC, r.RESEARCH_NO DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT page.RESEARCH_NO, page.RESEARCH_TITLE, page.RESEARCH_CONTENTS, page.ADD_COMMENT, COALESCE( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP a WHERE a.RESEARCH_NO = page.RESEARCH_NO ), 0 ) AS APP_CNT, COALESCE( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP a WHERE a.RESEARCH_NO = page.RESEARCH_NO AND (a.PROVIDE_YN IS NULL OR a.PROVIDE_YN != 'Y') ), 0 ) AS APP_NEW_CNT, page.COMPANY_NAME, page.SERVER_NAME, page.CONTACT_NO, page.BROKERAGE_AMT, page.CALCULATE_YN, page.REMARK, page.REGIST_DT, page.MODIFY_DT, page.CLOSE_DATE FROM ( SELECT r.RESEARCH_NO, r.RESEARCH_TITLE, r.RESEARCH_CONTENTS, r.ADD_COMMENT, r.COMPANY_NAME, r.SERVER_NAME, r.CONTACT_NO, r.BROKERAGE_AMT, r.CALCULATE_YN, r.REMARK, r.REGIST_DT, r.MODIFY_DT, r.CLOSE_DATE FROM TB_RESEARCH_MST r WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) ASC, r.RESEARCH_NO DESC ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) DESC, r.RESEARCH_NO DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) ASC, r.RESEARCH_NO DESC ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(r.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) DESC, r.RESEARCH_NO DESC
ORDER BY r.RESEARCH_NO DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) page
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) ASC, page.RESEARCH_NO DESC ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) DESC, page.RESEARCH_NO DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) ASC, page.RESEARCH_NO DESC ORDER BY CASE WHEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(page.REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 14) DESC, page.RESEARCH_NO DESC
ORDER BY page.RESEARCH_NO DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESEARCH_MST r WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT RESEARCH_NO FROM TB_RESEARCH_MST WHERE LENGTH(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8)) = 8 AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(CLOSE_DATE AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) < #{closeDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RESEARCH_MST ( RESEARCH_NO, RESEARCH_TITLE, RESEARCH_CONTENTS, ADD_COMMENT, APP_CNT, APP_NEW_CNT, COMPANY_NAME, SERVER_NAME, CONTACT_NO, BROKERAGE_AMT, CALCULATE_YN, REMARK, REGIST_DT, MODIFY_DT, CLOSE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{researchTitle}, #{researchContents}, #{addComment}, 0, 0, #{companyName}, #{serverName}, #{contactNo}, #{brokerageAmt}, #{calculateYn}, #{remark}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{closeDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RESEARCH_MST SET RESEARCH_TITLE = #{researchTitle}, RESEARCH_CONTENTS = #{researchContents}, ADD_COMMENT = #{addComment}, COMPANY_NAME = #{companyName}, SERVER_NAME = #{serverName}, CONTACT_NO = #{contactNo}, BROKERAGE_AMT = #{brokerageAmt}, CALCULATE_YN = #{calculateYn}, REMARK = #{remark}, CLOSE_DATE = #{closeDate}, MODIFY_DT = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo}
